titles.romaji: Fuyu no Chikai, Natsu no Matsuri: Takeo no Ookusu
titles.native: 冬の誓い　夏の祭り　武雄の大楠

description:
The anime is set in the city of Takeoshi, and will center on two characters, a boy and a girl, who grow up watched over by a large camphor tree that endures the time and seasons. It will star Nao Touyama as Rinko Yamaguchi, and Nobunaga Shimazaki as Souta. It will screen in the Saga Prefectural Space and Science Museum.

(Source: Anime News Network)
